name: Suez shareholder consortium (Meridiam, Global Infrastructure Partners, Caisse des Dépôts/CNP Assurances, employee shareholders)
via: Stakes in SUEZ held via SUEZ Holding S.A.S.
note: SUEZ S.A.'s interim financial statements (H1 2025, section 1.1): SUEZ S.A. is 97% owned by SUEZ Holding S.A.S., held by Meridiam Sustainable Water & Waste Fund (40%), GIP IV Highbury Luxco (40%) and Caisse des Dépôts and CNP Assurances (20%), with 3% held by employees. SUEZ's governance page shows, in a shareholders chart, the current effective split: Meridiam 38.3%, Global Infrastructure Partners (a part of BlackRock) 38.3%, Caisse des Dépôts and CNP Assurances 18.8%, Go SUEZ employee shareholding 4.4%. The page describes Caisse des Dépôts as 'A French public-sector financial institution'.
